stories.title: Legal resident loses thousands seeking citizenship to AI immigration attorney | 7 On Your Side Investiates
stories.simple_summary: Someone paid an AI chatbot for help becoming a U.S. citizen, but lost thousands of dollars because the AI gave bad advice.
stories.why_it_matters: If you need legal help with immigration or anything important, talk to a real lawyer, not an AI tool — AI can make serious mistakes that cost you money.

stories.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
stories.simple_summary: Two big AI companies (OpenAI and Anthropic) are competing to offer better privacy protections for business customers' information.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large businesses — nothing you need to act on right now, but it's good that companies are taking privacy seriously.

stories.title: Sacramento nonprofit’s program helps ‘build a solution’ for organizations with AI
stories.simple_summary: A nonprofit in Sacramento is helping organizations use AI to solve problems.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a business, there may be local resources available to help you figure out if AI could help you — worth asking about in your area.

stories.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
stories.simple_summary: SpaceX and an AI coding company were rumored to be in talks, but the CEO says it's not true.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Elon Musk's AI company argues in court for end to state's fake nudity ban
stories.simple_summary: Elon Musk's AI company is fighting a law that bans fake nude images.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a legal fight between a tech company and a state — not something that affects you directly unless you're concerned about fake AI-generated images online.

stories.title: Stripe to buy OpenRouter as fintech expands deeper into AI
stories.simple_summary: A payment company (Stripe) is buying an AI tool company to expand its AI services.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
stories.simple_summary: Even though AI is becoming more common, many people are worried about it and don't trust it yet.
stories.why_it_matters: Your caution about AI is shared by lots of other people — it's okay to be skeptical and careful about where and how you use it.

stories.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
stories.simple_summary: Google is adding AI study tools to help students learn better.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren who study, they may soon have an easier way to use AI to help with homework and research.

stories.title: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
stories.simple_summary: Google is creating a special section of its AI tool (Gemini) designed for students, with flashcards, practice tests, and note-taking.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren or know students, this is a free tool that could help them study — worth suggesting if they need homework help.

stories.title: Researchers say OpenAI revoked their access to limited cyber program
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI stopped letting some outside researchers use its AI tool to find security problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech security experts — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Meet the startup helping Wall Street put a price on AI compute
stories.simple_summary: A new company is helping Wall Street investors figure out fair prices for AI computing power (the expensive computer work needed to run AI).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to big investors and companies building AI — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI hit the brakes. Now what?
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI slowed down its AI development work to improve safety and security instead of rushing ahead.
stories.why_it_matters: It's a good sign that a major AI company is taking time to make sure their tools are safe — this affects any AI you might use in the future.
